summary: Tennessee Land Forms lists a Butler tower in Madison County at 597 ft as standing, but no build, staffing or fire history was found and the 2014 NRHP extant list does not name it.

facts.status_note: Marked standing on the undated Tennessee Land Forms list; not named in the NRHP document's list of extant towers as of March 26, 2014. Current condition unknown.

evidence.supports: a tower named Butler appears on the state lookout list
the list places the tower in Madison County and marks it standing
the NRHP document's extant-tower list is dated March 26, 2014
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: the Butler community is an unincorporated community in Johnson County, Tennessee
evidence.quote: unincorporated community in Johnson County in the northeastern corner of the U.S. state of Tennessee

evidence.supports: that Butler community lies along the northern shore of Watauga Lake
evidence.quote: located along the northern shore of Watauga Lake

evidence.supports: the list gives the tower an elevation of 597 feet

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975 (NRHP multiple property document)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Tennessee Land Forms (undated) says standing; the 2014 NRHP extant list does not name a Butler tower. Status is kept as standing with a note; it is not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Only the Tennessee Land Forms list names this tower. The name matches Butler, Tennessee, which is in Johnson County, not Madison County; the Madison County placement is unverified and may be wrong, so the record's county should be checked against a primary list (for example Madison County or Tennessee Division of Forestry records) before any change. Two WebSearch queries and the NRHP text turned up no build, staffing or fire history. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this tower is in the crawl cache. The coordinates in the record (35.4973, -88.7922) were not checked against any source. On 2026-10-09 a full-text search of the 2014 NRHP document for 'Butler' returned no match, which supports the story's statement that the 2014 list does not name a Butler tower.
